item_name: Rothco US Flag Reusable 3 Layer Facemask
item_short_desc: Show off your American spirit while staying protected with Rothco's US Flag Reusable 3 Layer Facemask. Designed for everyday use, this face mask features a soft and stretchy 3-layer polyester construction that contorts to the shape of your face for a comfortable fit and feel. The US flag design adds a stylish and patriotic touch to your daily essentials. The adjustable nose bridge ensures a secure fit, while the ear loops on each end hold the mask in place.
description: Show off your American spirit while staying protected with Rothco's US Flag Reusable 3 Layer Facemask. Designed for everyday use, this face mask features a soft and stretchy 3-layer polyester construction that contorts to the shape of your face for a comfortable fit and feel. The US flag design adds a stylish and patriotic touch to your daily essentials. The adjustable nose bridge ensures a secure fit, while the ear loops on each end hold the mask in place. Measuring 7 inches wide by 5 inches high (3 ¼ inches at the sides), this reusable face mask is available in 2 sizes: Small/Medium and Large/X-Large. The SM/MD size spans 11 inches from ear loop to ear loop (extended but not stretched), and the LG/XL size spans 14 inches from ear loop to ear loop (extended but not stretched). These masks are washable and reusable, making them a practical and eco-friendly choice. Please note that these masks are not medical-grade surgical masks nor N95 respirator masks. Rothco makes no warranties or implications that this mask prevents infection or the transmission of viruses or diseases.
